step1.description:
The past year has really been a resurgence for Angular, between modernizing APIs with Standalone Components, embracing a new reactive model with Signals, and pushing forward in working into SSR and Hydration. But amazing work has also been happening outside of Google, with Analog, a meta-framework built on Vite for Angular. Brandon Roberts author of Analog joins us to talk about what he's been building.
